newsitem.title: USA: Snyder says share price hurt by industry softness.
newsitem.headline: Snyder says share price hurt by industry softness.

text.p: Snyder Communications Inc said Tuesday that it will accelerate the release of its 1997 first quarter financial results to April 24, from April 28. The company said its fundamentals are unchanged and continue to be strong.
Snyder added that the movement in the price of its stock may be the result of softness or the down trend in the stock prices of traditional teleservices companies.
Shares of the company were trading at 20-7/8 mid-Tuesday afternoon, but closed Monday at 22-1/2.
The company said that teleservices at Snyder only augment its main business of outsourced marketing solutions for Fortune 500 companies.
The company also noted that teleservice revenues will represent less than 15 percent of its first quarter revenues.
